subject: Can't Model SiteCovs and ObsCovs Together

messages.author: 67eefb0e32c64fae
messages.subject: Can't Model SiteCovs and ObsCovs Together
parts:
Hi there!

I am running into an issue where I cannot combine site covariates and observation covariates into the same model. When I try to combine site.region (site-level) with effort and experience (observation-level) I get the error below. 

fmX <- colext(psiformula = ~1, gammaformula = ~1, epsilonformula = ~1, pformula = ~unlist(site.region) + obs.effort + obs.exphrs, data = FosnUMF, se = TRUE)

Error in model.frame.default(detformula, obsCovs, na.action = NULL) : 
  variable lengths differ (found for 'obs.effort')

This must be because site.region is not as large as the two obsCovs? How do I go about creating a data.frame of the right size?

messages.author: 67eefb0e32c64fae
messages.subject: Re: Can't Model SiteCovs and ObsCovs Together
parts:
Resolved!

SR <- cbind(site.region, replicate(13, site.region$Region)) #Duplicates the SiteCov across the 14 site visits as a data frame
fmX <- colext(psiformula = ~1, gammaformula = ~1, epsilonformula = ~1, pformula = ~unlist(SR) + obs.effort + obs.exphrs, data = FosnUMF, se = TRUE) #Adds SiteCov to model

I am now running into issues trying to predict specific detection probability values for this model... I keep getting the error: Error: ncol(coefficients) == length(obj@estimates) is not TRUE

Code:

newDataX2 <- data.frame(SR = factor("EGB", levels = c("EGB", "SWC")), obs.effort = 4, obs.exphrs = 200)
predict(fmX, newdata = newDataX2,type = 'det', appendData=TRUE)

Error: ncol(coefficients) == length(obj@estimates) is not TRUE
